subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What actual-runtime-model metadata contract should Gateway expose for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible HTTP responses?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but ordinary response headers cannot represent model selection that happens after SSE headers are flushed, so implementation needs maintainer intent on the public API shape.

options.title: Define unified HTTP/SSE metadata
options.body: Document and implement one actual-model contract for Chat Completions and Responses across non-streaming response metadata and streaming SSE-compatible metadata.

options.title: Limit the first pass to non-streaming
options.body: Expose actual-model metadata only where it is known before response headers are sent and leave streaming attribution as an explicit follow-up limitation.

options.title: Defer to broader runtime metadata
options.body: Keep transport response attribution deferred until the broader resolved-model and session-status metadata contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Define unified HTTP/SSE metadata
recommendation.body: Document and implement one actual-model contract for Chat Completions and Responses across non-streaming response metadata and streaming SSE-compatible metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact Gateway HTTP contract gap and has the strongest recent Gateway HTTP/docs history signal.
